actions.label: De-addiction referral and enhanced DOTS
actions.description: Refer patient to nearest de-addiction centre. Increase DOT frequency. Involve family member as treatment supporter.

actions.label: Gender-sensitive counseling with family involvement
actions.description: Provide targeted counseling addressing male-specific dropout patterns. Involve spouse or family elder as treatment supporter.

actions.label: Extended DOT with drug susceptibility testing
actions.description: Ensure DST completed before or early in treatment. Extend directly observed therapy frequency. Monitor closely for resistance patterns.

actions.label: NIKSHAY transfer-out and mobile follow-up
actions.description: Register transfer-out in NIKSHAY. Coordinate with receiving DOT center. Obtain multiple contact numbers. Schedule phone follow-ups.

actions.label: Proactive antiemetic prescription and dose timing adjustment
actions.description: Prescribe antiemetics before nausea worsens. Adjust dose timing (after meals vs before). Reassure patient side effects are manageable and temporary.

actions.label: Integrated TB-HIV care coordination
actions.description: Coordinate with ART center. Synchronize visit schedules. Monitor drug interactions. Ensure CPT (cotrimoxazole preventive therapy).

actions.label: Nikshay Poshan Yojana enrollment and travel support
actions.description: Enroll patient in Nikshay Poshan Yojana (Rs 500/month nutritional support). Arrange travel vouchers or reimbursement. Explore community DOT closer to home.

actions.label: Tobacco cessation counseling and referral
actions.description: Provide brief tobacco cessation counseling at every visit. Refer to cessation support if available. Document smoking status at each visit.

actions.label: Psychosocial support and shorter regimen evaluation
actions.description: Assess eligibility for shorter DR-TB regimen. Arrange psychosocial counseling. Connect with patient support group. Schedule more frequent check-ins.

actions.label: Community DOT provider or domiciliary visits
actions.description: Assign community DOT provider near patient's residence. Switch to domiciliary (home-based) DOT. Reduce patient travel burden.

actions.label: Peer support and flexible visit scheduling
actions.description: Connect with peer supporter of similar age. Adjust DOT timing to avoid work/college conflicts. Use evening or weekend slots if available.

actions.label: Anticipatory counseling — treatment completion reinforcement
actions.description: Reinforce that feeling better does NOT mean bacteria are gone. Explain that stopping early creates drug-resistant TB. Show sputum conversion results if available. Emphasize remaining treatment duration.

actions.label: Integrated TB-diabetes care
actions.description: Coordinate with diabetes care provider. Monitor blood sugar at TB visits. Adjust diabetes medication if needed. Ensure both conditions are managed together.

actions.label: Community health worker engagement and social support mapping
actions.description: Assign ASHA/CHW for regular home visits. Map available social support (neighbors, community groups, NGOs). Ensure patient is not socially isolated.

actions.label: Pictorial medication cards and vernacular counseling
actions.description: Provide pictorial cards showing which medicine to take when. Use local language for all counseling. Simplify instructions. Verify understanding using teach-back method.

actions.label: Schedule home visit before next scheduled dose
actions.description: Do not wait for missed dose. Proactively schedule home visit. Contact ANM supervisor. Confirm patient intent to continue treatment.

actions.label: Escalate to TB supervisor / District TB Officer
actions.description: Notify STS/STLS supervisor. Request intervention from District TB Officer if patient is at critical risk. Document escalation in NIKSHAY.
